notes.title: Going Wild on the Wild West!
notes.content:
Howdy Partners!

Are you excited about the Cowboys & Rustlers announcement? Because we are! We want to share a bit of news about the game setting. In Cowboys & Rustlers, you’ll be in charge of conquering the very weird Wild West! In this hilarious open-world game, you could bump into many strange (at first glance) things. Cowboys & Rustler is a comedic, story-driven adventure about true friendship with a horse. As you see on the trailer, the horse can talk. Wait, what? Isn't that strange? - no, it is not. In the Cowboys & Rustlers universe, everything is possible!

[previewyoutube=FDunfgA7nsc;full][/previewyoutube]
A new approach to the classic westerns!
It’s not a typical Wild West. Although it might look familiar with old Western movies, citizens of this land know a lot about making life easier with technology! As there is a lot of sun in the region, houses are equipped with solar panels to maintain the electricity. The trend of being eco-friendly reached this land too! Many cowboys, tired from robbing the bank or dueling with each other, enjoy skateboarding and doing crazy flips on ramps in local skateparks. However, It’s just a few examples of the craziness you will experience, free-roaming this world.

Crazy Activities!
Besides the main story, the world of Cowboys & Rustlers will be filled with many activities to accomplish, places to visit, heads to hunt, and bastards to duel with! Earn some money by robbing the banks, hop on the trains, and take control over them (Beware of hardcore roller coasters! ), and become the champion of poker (Don’t have lucky cards? No problem. Change their symbol using a pen or something else! Sounds not fair? This is the Wild West - you set the rules!

Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303530/

Sometimes, we will be throwing up cool quotes from Wild West. They might sound random, but cool, as the whole Wild West! Anyway, if you like any of them, you win. Do you get it? You win without shooting anyone! Wait, what I was supposed to say? Ah, your random Wild West quote for today is: 

“Don’t try another man’s hat.
It’s almost as bad as getting on his horse.”

Cowboys & Rustlers Team
